column1: # ea-index: EA -> discoveries documents that mention it. Generated by tools/ea-index.py; never edit by hand.
# BOUNDARY: records WHERE an EA is mentioned, not whether the mention is correct or current.
#   Superseded docs stay in the index; judge them by the reader (see canonical-fact-sheet).
#   Scope: discoveries/*.md only (not tasks/, not src/, not docs/f3/, not the IDB).
#   Keys are literal addresses; 0x45c140 and 0x45c141 are unrelated keys here.

# corpus_docs=140 indexed_eas=5265 mentions=7810 refused_tokens=763 {'vftable slot offset (relative to an unresolved table)': 565, 'bare all-digit hex: could be a decimal count, not indexed': 14, 'outside image span 0x400000-0x715800': 113, 'ambiguous +0x hex: struct offset vs global address': 5, 'masked/pattern EA (N significant digits, not an address)': 64, 'range outside image': 2}
# 51 keys are backed ONLY by inference from compressed prose (slash lists like @0x45c251/261/271,
#   zero-padded or after-offset suffixes). They are real but not literally written: list with --inferred.
#   Every other key appears literally as 0x.../sub_.../name_0x... in at least one document.
